scope.reviewed: bounded caller loop over three rows with one selected predicate, original row helper chain, output status and SP

findings.result: All 24 fixture combinations pass in isolation with candidate replay JSON byte-identical. Original 4C04 invokes the full cap/query/difference/type-6 chain without helper interception for the single selected enabled type-6 row. Disabled or type-7 rows are skipped. The valid initial-state path returns zero after type-6 processing; invalid initial state contributes status bit1. Cap/difference output, postprocessing flags, outer call observations, accumulated return and SP assertions pass.
Source and all receipt-listed artifact hashes match. Fixtures vary selected row index 0..2, enable bit, type6/7 and validity state, while keeping other row predicates disabled.

limitations: Only one row is selected/enabled in each fixture, so interactions among multiple active rows are not demonstrated.
Arbitrary row configurations, aliasing, concurrency, physical sensor behavior, and caller/firmware completeness remain unresolved.
No canonical admission or C implementation.

checks.command: source and receipt artifact hash verification
